name: Paper Folding
description: Generate folded grid-paper punch problems and reconstruct all four answers from the printed panels.
steps: Select a pattern and inspect its representative original
Record the intended inference, condition, closest foil and distinguishing evidence
Choose strip folds, a terminal corner and distinct punches
Run the official grid model, drawing routines and compositor
Solve the printed layers and compare four distinct unfolded grids
Check the declared inference and revise the named option or condition if needed
Review the final PNG and record the accepted version
